**Recent AI News – November – December 2024 (Quick‑Look)**  

Below is a concise roundup of the most‑talked‑about AI developments that have surfaced in the last two months, drawn from publicly‑available news snippets (links included). If you need deeper coverage on any story, just let me know and I can dig further.

| Date (2024) | Headline / Topic | Why It Matters | Source |
|-------------|------------------|----------------|--------|
| **Nov 7** | **Google’s “AI for Science” Forum & AlphaFold 3 code release** | Google announced a new AI‑for‑Science forum and opened the model code for AlphaFold 3, accelerating protein‑folding research and open‑science collaboration. | 【7 pieces of AI news we announced in November】 |
| **Nov 14** | **Microsoft Ignite 2024 – Copilot & AI infrastructure updates** | Microsoft unveiled new Copilot extensions for Office, Azure AI super‑clusters, and tighter integration with GitHub Copilot, signaling a push to make generative AI a core productivity layer. | 【Top 8 Stories in Recent AI News: November 2024】 |
| **Nov 21** | **Cerebras “record‑breaking” wafer‑scale AI processor** | Cerebras announced a new wafer‑scale engine that delivers 2× the FLOPs of its predecessor, underscoring the continuing hardware race for large‑scale generative models. | 【Top 8 Stories in Recent AI News: November 2024】 |
| **Nov 25** | **U.S. “TRAIN” Act introduced** | The Transparency and Responsibility for Artificial Intelligence Networks (TRAIN) Act was introduced to require audit‑ability and provenance tracking for high‑risk AI systems. | 【Key AI Developments in November 2024】 |
| **Nov 30** | **OpenAI “o3” model nearing human‑level performance on complex reasoning** | Early benchmarks suggest OpenAI’s upcoming o3 model can solve multi‑step reasoning tasks at near‑human accuracy, raising both excitement and policy concerns. | 【Latest AI News December 2024 (CallGPT)】 |
| **Dec 3** | **Databricks raises $10 B (Series J) – valuation > $300 B** | The AI‑cloud data platform’s massive funding round highlights investor confidence in unified AI‑analytics platforms and positions Databricks as a key competitor to Snowflake and Azure. | 【AI 2024 in review (IoT‑Analytics)】 |
| **Dec 6** | **Nvidia launches new generative‑AI voice & sound model** | Nvidia’s latest multimodal model adds high‑fidelity audio generation, opening new possibilities for virtual assistants, games, and media creation. | 【AI Update, Dec 6 2024 (MarketingProfs)】 |
| **Dec 12** | **Amazon “Olympus” multimodal model (text, image, video)** | According to The Information (reported on OpenAI community), Olympus can process and generate across three modalities, marking Amazon’s entry into the next wave of foundation models. | 【AI Pulse News Roundup (Dec 2024)】 |
| **Dec 17** | **Google AI updates – models, consumer products, research** | Google’s December roundup highlighted improvements to Gemini models, new AI‑enhanced features in Google Workspace, and a suite of research papers on AI safety. | 【The latest AI news we announced in December】 |
| **Dec 20** | **UNESCO adopts AI‑powered Global Outlook on Racism & Discrimination** | UNESCO integrated a partner AI system to analyze worldwide data on racism, showcasing AI’s role in large‑scale social‑policy research. | 【News & Updates | AI Innovation in Global Business】 |
| **Dec 22** | **Regulatory spotlight – EU AI Act “post‑implementation” guidance** | The European Commission released its first detailed guidance on compliance pathways for the AI Act, affecting all providers operating in the EU. | 【Artificial intelligence – BBC News】 |

### Themes & Take‑aways

1. **Enterprise‑grade generative AI is becoming a platform layer** – Microsoft’s Copilot expansion, Nvidia’s audio model, and Google’s Workspace AI features all point to AI being baked directly into productivity suites and cloud services.

2. **Hardware continues to scale** – Cerebras’ wafer‑scale chip and Nvidia’s new AI‑focused GPUs underline the race for compute power needed for ever‑larger foundation models.

3. **Funding & valuations are soaring** – Databricks’ $10 B raise (Series J) signals massive market confidence in AI‑centric data platforms.

4. **Regulation is gaining traction** – The U.S. TRAIN Act and EU AI Act guidance show governments moving from discussion to concrete compliance frameworks.

5. **Multimodal breakthroughs** – Amazon’s Olympus and Nvidia’s audio model illustrate the industry shift from text‑only models to systems that understand and generate across text, images, video, and sound.

6. **Open‑science momentum** – Google’s release of AlphaFold 3 code and the AI‑for‑Science forum demonstrate a growing willingness to share foundational research tools.
